pages.title: Power Across Mods
pages.text:
Create runs on **rotation**. Many other machines run on **Forge Energy (FE)**. They never mix on their own: you need a converter block in between.

Full detail: [#](2E5AAC)[Rotation vs Electricity](entry://industry/power_compared)[#]().

pages.title: Rotation to FE
pages.text: Crafts & Additions' Alternator turns spin into FE. It needs at least 32 RPM.

pages.title: FE to Rotation
pages.text: Crafts & Additions' Electric Motor turns FE back into spin at the RPM you set.

Rotation sources beyond water, wind and steam:
- TFMG engines burning oil products
- The Create Nuclear reactor
- Create Propulsion's Stirling Engine, which turns heat into spin
- Electric Motors running on FE

Things that want FE: Create Propulsion's Ion Thruster, Flight Control's vector ion thrusters and the Deep Seas Electrolyzer on submarines.

TFMG wires its own voltage circuits, but its connectors can import or export FE.
